item: Pitch 2 item 7 (07_evolved_eyes, option A Trim), plan Task 12, branch kitb-p2-eyes
status: WAITING FOR THE OWNER: export re-bake + upload in the keyed cloud session. Nothing was uploaded and no committed manifest, meshes.json entry or MeshIds id was changed from the PC.
handOver: 2026-11-20, after the owner's RE-BAKE decision: the export re-bake was built and checked on the PC (98 FBX, bpy 5.2.2), still NOT uploaded and still no committed manifest / meshes.json / MeshIds change. The upload steps, the 98 FBX (path, size, sha256) and the renders are in build/upload_sheets/evo_eyes_UPLOAD.md + build/upload_sheets/evo_eyes/; follow that file (it replaces the steps below).
why: Every evolved body key (evo1_* / evo2_*, High and _low) has a MeshIds id, so in the arena and as a follower the pet is drawn from the baked mesh, whose eyes are baked into the body MeshParts. The trimmed EYE_MASKS.Evo / EvoFierce reach only the Part build (fallback while a mesh loads, or when it fails) until these keys are re-baked from this source and uploaded.

dryBake.how: blender/build_all.py --no-export (lupa, no bpy) run into a scratch folder for the parent commit c733fe0 and for c116b44 (the eye commit); the repo's src/, blender/out and blender/meshes.json were not written
dryBake.lowKeysToo: the _low meshes are cut from the same High sculpt at a lower K, so they carry the trimmed eye as well (EvoLow 4x4 is only the Low Part build)
dryBake.wingsUnchanged: 22 evowing keys of the 4 pets checked: contentHash equal to the live ones
dryBake.parentReproducesLive: 94 of 98 keys: the bake at the parent commit gives exactly the committed contentHash, so for them the re-bake is eyes only
dryBake.olderDriftNote: these keys were already stale before the eye change (their live mesh is older than today's design): a re-bake also ships that older drift; look at their previews before uploading
dryBake.preview: build/upload_sheets/evo_eyes_rebake_preview.png (render_model meshevo: live mesh | re-baked mesh for Phantom Kitsune 1 + 2, Stormfang 1 + 2, Candy Unicorn 1, Twilight Dragon 1 Low; Low wings drawn as boxes because their tris were not baked for the preview)

uploaderExpectation: structureHash changes on all 98 keys, so tools/upload_assets.py makes NEW assets (POST), not PATCH: every evo id in MeshIds.lua changes and each new asset goes through moderation (until approved those pets fall back to the Part build)
doNot: Do not commit re-baked MeshManifests/evo*.lua or meshes.json from a PC ahead of the upload: with the old ids the old assets no longer match the new manifests (part names / sizes changed): MeshLibrary's fit refuses a key (missing part or fit error -> the Part build, up to 380 / 520 parts per evolved pet) or, where the part names still line up, places old geometry in the new part boxes. Manifests, meshes.json, upload_state.json and MeshIds.lua land together in one commit from the upload session.
steps: Owner says go (this is an upload: owner's call).

Keyed cloud session, on the branch that has the eye change (kit-b after its merge): /tmp/claude-0/bpyenv/bin/python blender/build_all.py --class evolved --preview   (export build, docs/phase6/OWNER_UPLOAD.md section 2)
Look at the previews (blender/out/previews) for the 4 drift keys and the arena pets before uploading.
python3 tools/upload_assets.py --class evolved   (dry run: expect 98 new-asset, the evowing keys skipped)

python3 tools/upload_assets.py --upload --class evolved   (section 5), then commit MeshManifests + blender/meshes.json + blender/upload_state.json + src/shared/MeshIds.lua together and run the --mesh suite
